prompt:
Use case: photorealistic visual learning assets for a children's Hanzi interactive playground; subject ID drum only.
Primary request: one vertical 1024x1792 photographic triptych containing exactly three separate landscape photographs stacked top to bottom, divided by two thin straight horizontal white seams, approximately 6 pixels thick. No outer border.
Top photograph: one complete handheld frame drum resting on a simple wooden tabletop, shown in three-quarter view so its circular natural skin drumhead and shallow wooden rim are clearly recognizable. Realistic wood grain, natural hide texture and small metal fasteners; no lettering or decoration.
Middle photograph: one complete classroom drum standing in a quiet, softly sunlit music classroom, with a cylindrical wooden shell, taut pale drumhead and a simple low stand. The entire instrument and stand are visible, with a softly blurred classroom background and no people; no writing on the walls or instrument.
Bottom photograph: one complete large bass drum mounted upright on a simple metal floor stand in an uncluttered music practice room, shown in three-quarter view so the deep wooden shell and large circular pale drumhead are visible. Entire drum and supporting stand fit inside the frame; no logos on the drumhead.
Composition/framing: each panel is a standalone wide landscape photograph of equal height, with the complete main drum and any supporting stand centered and at least 8 percent crop-safe empty margin on every side. Show physically plausible drum construction and clear differences between the hand drum, classroom drum and bass drum. No clipped drum rims or stand feet. Each panel must remain useful when independently cropped.
Style/medium: authentic photorealistic photography, natural detail, tactile wood grain and drumhead textures, realistic metal hardware, credible proportions, no illustration, cartoon, CGI or toy-like rendering.
Lighting/mood: gentle natural daylight, believable soft shadows and true-to-life colors, calm and welcoming.
Constraints: exactly three panels in the specified order; exactly two thin white horizontal seams; no readable text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, brands, watermark, captions or decorative graphics; no people.
reviewNotes: Read-inspected the actual 1024x1792 PNG. Top: complete handheld frame drum with metal jingles (a tambourine), natural hide head and wood rim on a wooden table; plant and chair in background. Middle: complete conga-style wooden classroom hand drum on a low black stand in a sunlit music classroom; extra small instruments and blank music stand in background. Bottom: complete upright bass drum with wooden shell, pale drumhead, tension hardware and wheeled metal stand. Natural material textures and daylight; no visible people, readable text, brands or watermarks. Pixel measurement found white seam rows 570–577 and 1157–1164; cuts 574 and 1161 are their rounded centers. Panels are not exactly equal height. Instruments remain within the frame, but middle drum and bottom stand have less than the requested 8 percent vertical margin; the prepare.cjs 8-pixel inset still leaves them intact.
